title: Chapter 194: The Pragmatic Goblin Elder
content:
Chapter 194: The Pragmatic Goblin Elder

Once again, Wu Qing captured a castle of the demon tribe and eliminated a large number of demon tribe troops, which made him earn a lot of resources.

It was too early to find out, but the Zerg long-range troops needed to rest and recover, and the Zerg should not fight again.

The Zerg army rested for a while, and returned to the Naga city at the request of Naga.

As Wu Qing expected, Naga was ready to give up the newly captured castle of the demon tribe first, and then occupy it after the Naga tribe was ready and launched a full-scale counterattack.

There was nothing for Wu Qing to do afterwards, so he just left it to host No. 3 to deal with.

…

Wu Qing returned to the underground world battlefield, where the intensity of the battle was already very low. The ghouls could not break the strong defense line of the Zerg, and their enthusiasm for attacking was greatly reduced.

After Wu Qing obtained a large amount of resources again, he increased the number of cockroaches on the underground world battlefield to 5,000, the number of destroyers to 1,000, and the number of flying dragons to 25,000, greatly strengthening the defense line of the Zerg army, and the ghouls began to lie down.

The number of ghouls that actively attack the Zerg army's defense line is getting smaller and smaller, so the Zerg army has to take the initiative to attack and stimulate the ghouls to make them more active.

Twenty-five thousand flying dragons, divided into two groups, continue to attack and plunder resources for Wu Qing.

The Zerg army has the triple long-range strike capabilities of destroyers, hydralisks and cockroaches. Unless there is absolute strength to suppress them, it is really difficult to deal with them.

The Zerg army only stays in a small area near the underground world barrier, and the ghouls have no way to deal with it.

Wu Qing has asked the Zerg worker bees to continuously expand the passage from the Zerg underground territory to the underground world. As long as the mysterious enemy does not come out to make trouble, when this passage is large enough, Wu Qing will extend the Zerg territory.

At that time, they can gain a foothold in the Zerg territory and occupy a piece of land in the underground world.

If the scope of the Zerg territory can be extended to the underground world, the difficulty of the Zerg conquering the underground world will be much lower.

The stable battlefield in the underground world can be left to the Queen of Insects. Wu Qing has another very important thing to do today.

…

Wu Qing's insect clone in Guangfu City has already gone to Mengzhong City with his personal guards.

Gong Zhe of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce sent a message that the team of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to build a branch will arrive soon, accompanied by the senior staff of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

Gong Zhe emphasized that this senior staff is not like those fake senior staff of a branch of the Tengu tribe, but the real core staff of the Goblin tribe, and needs to be contacted by someone with status in the Zerg tribe.

This real senior staff of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce should be regarded as an upper-class staff in this world. Wu Qing should have a lot of gains if he contacts him personally.

The Zerg's scouting dogs have discovered a large-scale goblin caravan. It is definitely not an exaggeration to say that it is large, but this caravan is really very large.

The eight-legged spider-like goblin transport vehicles are one after another, stretching endlessly, and countless.

From time to time, you can see even larger special goblin transport vehicles, some of which are loaded with a large amount of supplies, and some are loaded with a large number of people.

Through the perspective of the Zerg puppy, Wu Qing felt that the Goblin Chamber of Commerce had moved a city here.

The Zerg puppy ran along the caravan openly and found that there were at least 3,000 goblin transport vehicles of various models in this caravan.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone rushed to Mengzhong City, and the front car of this goblin caravan just entered the scope of Mengzhong City.

A large number of Zerg puppies appeared and stopped the various reconnaissance teams that followed the goblin caravan all the way.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce was going to build a branch in Mengzhong City, and even the nearest Tengu tribe didn't know about this news.

The Tengu tribe only knew that Gong Zhe's caravan stopped in Mengzhong City, but for some reason, they didn't think about the Goblin Chamber of Commerce building a branch.

For a super chamber of commerce like the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, the establishment of each branch is a major decision and a matter of great caution. Suddenly building a branch here is something that no one, not to mention the Tengu tribe, could have expected.

The reason why the Goblin Chamber of Commerce listened to Gong Zhe's advice and made such a decision is that the Zerg's energy coins are of great importance. They can only provide strong support to the Zerg in this way in exchange for the exclusive exchange rights of the Zerg's energy coins.

This is to seize the initiative and take the lead. As long as the Goblin Chamber of Commerce takes the lead, even if the news of the Zerg's energy coins is leaked in the future, the Goblins will have taken the lead.

The Goblin Chamber of Commerce sent such a large caravan this time, which has greatly exceeded the scope of Gong Zhe's application, just to show sincerity to the Zerg.

Wu Qing did not expect the Goblin Chamber of Commerce to invest so much. Looking at this posture, if the branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce is built, it is estimated that it will not be much smaller than Mengzhong City.

"Lord!"

Gong Zhe was already waiting for Wu Qing. As soon as Wu Qing's insect clone arrived, he came to greet him.

"Let's go! Let's go meet the elders of your chamber of commerce first!"

The caravan of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce had arrived. Without saying much, the two went forward to greet them.

The caravan was led by a transport vehicle that looked similar to an ordinary goblin transport vehicle, but with Wu Qing's knowledge of machinery, he could see that this goblin transport vehicle was fundamentally different from other transport vehicles.

Wu Qing was not mistaken. This goblin transport vehicle was the vehicle used by the top leaders of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

The goblin transport truck stopped in front of Wu Qing and Gong Zhe, the door opened, and a lean old goblin man stepped out. Before they arrived, he heard his cursing voice: "This place is too remote! It’s a waste of time to come here!”

He walked down alone without any accompanying persons or goblin guardian robots.

Although Gong Zhe has not personally met this senior executive of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, he has relevant information and knows that this is Gong Rui, the elder of the Goblin clan, who holds an important position in the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

"Businessman Gong Zhe has met the elder!"

"Wu Qing, Lord of the Zerg Daxia Territory, has met the elder!"

The two went forward to greet them. Gong Zhe was very respectful, and Wu Qing was also polite and thoughtful without any slight.

Wu Qing felt a huge threat from this inconspicuous little old man of the goblin clan. His powerful spiritual sense had been frantically warning him.

Wu Qing is currently using a clone. The Queen of Insects can descend on him at any time as a three-star insect clone to exert powerful combat power, so he is not worried and forcibly suppresses the warning from his spiritual sense.

Wu Qing felt that the goblin elder named Gong Rui was much stronger than the Naga elder Naga. They were not on the same level at all.

Wu Qing can now confirm that the person coming this time is indeed a core member of the Goblin clan, not an ordinary "high-level person." This shows that the Goblin clan attaches great importance to the Zerg energy coins.

Fortunately, Wu Qing did not promote Zerg energy coins rashly, otherwise he doesn't know how many powerful people he would attract.

"Wu Qing? You are the Zerg's talker outside, right? Are you a human? Yes, yes!"

Gong Rui smiled and looked at Wu Qing's insect clone. He didn't know what he saw, and said "not bad" twice.

He looked at Gong Zhe again and said: "Gong Zhe, you are not bad. You have made great contributions to the clan this time. Do a good job!"

"Let's go, find a place and have a good chat. I'm pressed for time!"

Gong Rui didn't give the excited Gong Zhe a chance to speak, so he asked Gong Zhe to lead the way and find a place to chat with Wu Qing.

Wu Qing didn't pay attention to Gong Rui's attitude. He could see that Gong Rui was probably a technology research elder of the goblin tribe. In terms of human nature and sophistication, he couldn't compare with a businessman like Gong Zhe.

And as a core elder of the goblin tribe, this attitude is just right for him.

To be honest, the Zerg, a race that has just entered the world and has not shown its due strength at all, cannot be compared with the goblins, one of the most powerful races in the local race.

A lord of the Zerg tribe who has just established a territory is still a human race, and the identity of Gong Rui, the core elder of the goblin tribe, is not equivalent.

The three of them came to the room that Gong Zhe had prepared at the Goblin Chamber of Commerce's residence without any entourage.

"I'm not a businessman, so there are no such rules here!"

"I have a lot of things on my hands, and I don't have time to waste here. Do you understand what I mean?"

Gong Rui was the first to speak and set a tone for this meeting, which was to be pragmatic and efficient and not waste time.

"clear!"

Gong Zhe replied respectfully.

Wu Qing also smiled and said: "No problem!"

"Okay, everyone, please sit down!"

"Let me explain our clan's attitude first. Our clan attaches great importance to the Zerg energy coins and hopes to obtain the exclusive right to exchange the Zerg energy coins through fair means!"

"As long as the situation is under control, all the energy coins flowing out of the Zerg must go to our clan, and our clan will exchange them with products of equal value!"

"As compensation, our tribe will establish a branch of the Chamber of Commerce here to specifically meet the development needs of the Zerg tribe!"

"Moreover, the Zerg will gain the friendship of our clan. If we want to get out of here in the future, our clan can provide some help!"

"Lord Wu Qing, is there any problem with this?"

Gong Rui looked at Wu Qing and asked.

"No problem!"

Wu Qing replied.

"Okay! That's no problem. Then I'll ask a few questions that our clan is concerned about!"

"How much is the output of Zerg energy coins? Is it possible for our two races to cooperate and jointly conduct research on energy purification technology?"

Gong Rui looked at Wu Qing seriously and asked.

"The output of Zerg energy coins depends on the Zerg sacrifices on the battlefield. This high-purity energy coin can only be given by the Zerg master, and we have no control over it!

"All we can do is kill more enemies on the battlefield and sacrifice them!"

"As for the cooperative research between the two races on energy purification technology, the Zerg has certain technical reserves in this area and is also preparing to develop a Zerg energy coin that can truly be used for promotion!"

"If the nobles are interested, we can cooperate in this regard!"

Wu Qing thought for a while and replied.
